title: Spatiotemporal Images, Religious and Existential Orientation in the Poetry of Ibn Ḥazm al-Andalusī
core_idea: Examine Ibn Ḥazm’s spatiotemporal poetic images as an alternative medium to his prose for expressing religious visions and existential theories, exploring how images of time and place reflect his ideology under influences of Islamic culture and Greek philosophy using stylistic and cultural criticism.
tldr: Analyze how Ibn Ḥazm’s poetic images of time and place reveal his religious and existential thought, treating poetry as a complementary vehicle to his prose and situating it within Islamic and Greco-influenced frameworks.
